messages:
Priya Narang: Quick heads-up  Solstice QBR scheduled Fri, 15m with SVP Customer. Need: 1-slide "asks for exec", short onboarding gate summary, renewal pulse, and owners. Drive: https://tiny.redwood/solstice-qbr

Talia Brooks: I'll grab 30d active seats and the activation funnel. Will paste into slide 3 by EOD.

Omar Reyes: Renewal pulse = amber. Risks: stalled SSO claim mapping, analytics export not enabled, low trial-to-paid conversion. Recommend ask: approve 4-week extension + analytics priority + small enablement credit.

Hana Suzuki: I can run a focused 72-hour enablement blitz to get seat activations up. Requesting 6 SE-hours. I'll produce a 1-page runbook.

Priya Narang: Please add a 1-line "ask for exec" into slide 1 by EOD (keeps the deck tight). Also need a single-sentence renewal justification.

Talia Brooks: Uploaded seat heatmap and funnel. Notable drop at day 7 (~20% disengage). Added notes with assumptions.

Omar Reyes: SSO ticket assigned to Solstice infra team; ETA Thu EOD. Analytics export on backlog; escalation opened with PMs.

ops-bot: Reminder set: final deck review meeting on 2025-11-07 16:00 PST.

Priya Narang: Copying action items into thread for traceability:
```
- Hana: enablement blitz plan + SE-hours request (due Wed EOD)
- Talia: data slides + appendix (due Thu noon)
- Omar: SSO + analytics status update (due Thu 5pm)
- Priya: draft exec asks + one-line renewal rationale (due Fri morning)
```

Hana Suzuki: Will post the runbook by Wed and prepare a short demo script for the QBR appendix.

Talia Brooks: I'll be on the dry run.

Priya Narang: Dry run set Thu 09:00 (10m). Please keep remarks to 60s each. If any blockers pop up, drop them here. :rocket:

Omar Reyes: Added my one-line ask in the doc: "Approve 4-week pilot extension, temporary analytics access, and enablement credits to prove retention lift."

Hana Suzuki: Acknowledged. I'll prep slides for the enablement appendix.

Priya Narang: Thanks team. I'll circulate the final deck after the dry run.
